caption: The drawing depicts a laboratory test tube rack, rendered in grayscale pencil on a light beige background. The rack consists of a rectangular base and a parallel rectangular top section, both with similar proportions. Vertical cylindrical rods, evenly spaced, connect the base to the top, forming the main structure and providing slots to hold test tubes. The top section has two rows of circular holes designed to accommodate the test tubes. Additionally, one large circular clamp is attached to the left side of the rack, with its latch mechanism clearly drawn. At the center of the top panel, there is an upright loop handle. The drawing is composed within a faint outlined rectangle, and the artist's signature "Marie Famularo" is present in the bottom right corner. The entire composition uses shades of gray, with shading to indicate depth and dimension.
title: Candle Mold
